title: config/settings.yml
description: Runtime settings: how the system behaves, which AI model it uses, when it posts, and which platforms are switched on.

mode.$comment: LOCKED to 'review' by owner decision (2026-07-22): a human must merge the pull request before anything is published. 'auto' exists in this schema for a much later phase only.

model.$comment: Treated as an opaque id so switching models is a one-line change.

publisher.$comment: How posts reach the platforms. 'buffer' (owner-approved 2026-07-22) sends everything through the Buffer API with one token; 'direct' is the documented fallback that talks to each platform's own API.

timezone.$comment: An IANA timezone name like Asia/Kolkata. The validator also checks it is a real timezone.

slots.$comment: Named posting times of day, e.g. morning: "10:00". Times are local (see timezone) in 24-hour HH:MM.

author.$comment: 'company' is the MVP choice (owner-approved 2026-07-22): publishing goes through Buffer, whose LinkedIn connection already covers Company Pages - no LinkedIn API approval needed. 'personal' remains valid for the direct-API fallback path.
